title: IMTAN saturates to +-i for im > 354.5 or im < -354 before checking |re| >= 2^27 and rejects real |re| >= 2^27 with #NUM!
statement: In Excel 16.0 builds 20430 and 20527, IMTAN(inumber) checks im > 354.5 (returning "i") and im < -354.0 (returning "-i") before enforcing |re| < 2^27 = 134,217,728 (where |re| >= 2^27 returns #NUM!). Off-axis, it uses Excel's scalar circular kernels in (2*sin(re)*cos(re)) / (cosh(2*im) + 1 - 2*sin(re)^2) and flushes subnormal real quotients to 0; 1,267/1,267 pinned and 1,228/1,283 full-bank rows match (55 off-axis rows differ by up to 57 ULP on build 20527.20196).
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 (jnt_parity_complex rows 382-392, 603) and CalcFunc-Evidence cache/w111-extended-regenerated-20260929/answers-imtan.json.gz (Excel 16.0 build 20430); 1,267/1,267 pinned and 1,228/1,283 full-bank rows match.
